title: RAW UNREVIEWED: one herb has different internal and external application routes
summary: Seek a single complete dated medicinal entry that explicitly prescribes the same identified plant by ingestion for one condition and by external application to a named body site for another. Freeze the source's plant identity, preparation, route, recipient and indication for both clauses, then test only an already admitted whole target passage with independently established capacity for two such role sets. A generic shared plant name or treatment vocabulary cannot distinguish the two routes. No source pair, target passage or translated form is presently claimed; W89's paused recipe glosses cannot be reused as independent bindings.

design.mechanism: one source-owned herb retains identity across two clauses whose delivery route and patient site differ
design.unit: one complete dated medicinal entry and one complete already admitted candidate passage
design.contrast: internal delivery and external application with distinct indications versus undifferentiated plant-use listing
design.prediction: a fixed whole reading keeps the herb owner invariant but assigns separate written route, site and indication roles to both clauses; no independent target roles means no capacity
